The dialogue describes a patient with lifelong, non-inflammatory, non-pruritic, diffuse dry and scaly skin beginning at 6 months of age, with no family history of similar skin disease. Clinical features are consistent with a congenital ichthyosis. Histopathology shows **compact hyperkeratosis and reduced/absent granular layer**, a hallmark of *ichthyosis vulgaris* (often linked to *FLG* mutations) but also seen in some forms of autosomal recessive congenital ichthyosis (ARCI), particularly *TGM1*-related disease.
